title: Passage: Road to Rome
standardSummary: Read a travel passage with prepositions and pronouns; answer who goes where.
teach: Travel Latin with ad/ab/per/cum and ego/tū/is.

seeds.prompt: With whom do I come toward Rome?

passage.title: On the road
passage.latin:
Ego cum amīcīs ad Rōmam veniō.
Tū mēcum in viā ambulās.
Is ab urbe ad mare contendit.
Nōs per Italiam iter facimus.
passage.notes: Prepositions + personal pronouns · Use known vocabulary; guess from context only if needed.
